providers.name: Historisches Lexikon des Fürstentums Liechtenstein online
providers.what: The online edition of the historical encyclopaedia of Liechtenstein. The home page offers an A to Z article list, advanced search, a bibliography, an abbreviations list and a media gallery added in October 2026 that brings together over 1,300 multimedia items. New articles appear regularly; on the day the page showed a biographical article and one on an international bank. The state archive site (llv.li) blocked my request with a challenge page and was not read. I did not read an article.
providers.triageNote: Opened the home page on 2026-11-08; no article opened. llv.li (Landesarchiv) returned a Cloudflare challenge and was not worked round.

providers.name: Luxracines a.s.b.l. - Portail de la généalogie au Luxembourg
providers.what: A Luxembourg genealogy association with a portal for genealogy in the country. The site lists its library catalogue at Walferdange (open on set Saturdays, with a visit announced by e-mail the day before), a book market, members' sites, a search function and members' login. The list of latest library documents includes entries labelled 'Luxbg-Ville Personnalités', 'Aubange M Lux 1796-1950', 'Arlon M Lux 1796-1945' and 'Thionville M Lux', and it sells family books, including a volume of Luxembourg City marriages 1815 to 1832. I did not open any index, so I cannot say what is public or members-only.
providers.triageNote: Opened the home page on 2026-11-08; indexes and the catalogue not opened. Round 1 could not read anlux (existing row anlux-genealogie).

providers.name: Archives de la Ville de Bruxelles / Stadsarchief Brussel - Généalogie et archives en ligne
providers.what: The archive of the City of Brussels. Its genealogy page says it holds records for people born, married, dying or living in the City of Brussels, Laeken, Haren and Neder-Over-Heembeek only (other Brussels communes keep their own), namely parish registers and public civil-status acts: birth acts over 100 years old, marriage and death acts over 75 years old. The parish registers are consulted online only through the State Archives platform. The 'archives en ligne' page lists items online (commercial almanacs, a Brussels journal, golden books and municipal bulletins) and items for the reading room only, including population registers 1846 to 1900, population index 1856 to 1960, population censuses 1795 to 1842 and foreigners' files from about 1863 to 1935. I did not use the online catalogue.
providers.triageNote: Opened the home page, the genealogy page and the online-archives page on 2026-11-08. The catalogue was not opened. Related to the existing arch-be row (State Archives portal).

providers.name: Familiekunde Vlaanderen - Indices en databanken
providers.what: The Flemish genealogical society, a knowledge centre for family history in Flanders and Brussels. Its index page lists, per branch and municipality, indexes and databases made by the regional chapters, with links. Examples visible are death-memorial-card and funeral-letter collections for the West Coast, Tielt, Mandel-Leie, Bruges, Dilbeek and Leuven regions, conscription lists for the cantons around Dilbeek (years 7 and 13 of the revolutionary calendar), a mission-work index for the diocese of Bruges, and ancestor-table lists. Other menu items cover a library, publications, projects such as the Red Star Line, and the heraldic college. I did not open the linked databases, so I cannot say which need membership.
providers.triageNote: Opened the home page and the index page on 2026-11-08; the linked databases were not opened.

providers.name: Belgian War Dead Register (Registre des morts pour la patrie / Register Gesneuvelden)
providers.what: The register of Belgian fallen soldiers, run by the War Heritage Institute. Its search help page recommends searching broadly by surname first and then filtering, and trying other spellings, for example splitting a prefix. It states that the register covers Belgian fallen only and gives basic personal data (name, date and place of birth and so on) but not full military files. The files are kept at the Royal Military Museum for consultation on site or by the Defence archives service, depending on year of birth. I did not run a search or confirm the wars covered.
providers.triageNote: Opened the English search-tips page on 2026-11-08; no search run. Place is the museum's Brussels location, approximate.

providers.name: Brabants Historisch Informatie Centrum (BHIC) - Stamboom en andere databases
providers.what: The regional historical centre for North Brabant, in 's-Hertogenbosch. Its family-tree page searches persons across civil registration, population registers and baptism, marriage and burial books, and lists further databases: prison registers 1834 to 1929, militia registers for north-east Brabant 1814 to 1942, persons in the Council of Brabant 1586 to 1811, criminal judgments 1811 to 1930, justice-of-the-peace rulings 1811 to 1838, Belgian refugees at the Uden camp 1915 to 1920, summaries of notarial and aldermen's deeds to 1935, surety letters to 1811, communicants of the Reformed church at Grave 1676 to 1836, a brotherhood's members 1329 to 1620, death notes 1865 to 1976, and scanned sources. I did not run a search.
providers.triageNote: Opened the home page redirect and the family-tree page on 2026-11-08; searches not run.

providers.name: Gelders Archief, Arnhem - Personen (persons database)
providers.what: The regional archive of Gelderland. Its persons database makes archive items searchable by personal name, including civil-registry acts, baptism, marriage and burial books, population registrations and inheritance-declaration memorandums. The search has surname, particle, first name, role, source, place and period fields and wildcard marks (question mark for one letter, asterisk, a dollar sign for similar results, a minus to exclude). Linked help pages cover population registers, civil registry, church books, genealogy, Jewish genealogy and family research in Germany. The home page also offers photos and films, building files, archives and a free scan-on-request. I did not run a search.
providers.triageNote: Opened the home page and the persons page on 2026-11-08; no search run.

providers.name: Haags Gemeentearchief, The Hague - Bronnenoverzicht en Personen
providers.what: The municipal archive of The Hague. Its source overview lists sources and indexes once reserved for the reading room and now digital, each with an explanation and link: poor-relief recipients 1770 to 1860, population registers for The Hague and Loosduinen, orphan-chamber inventories, civil registry, collateral succession 1679 to 1805, tax defendants 1750 to 1810, baptism, marriage and burial books to 1811 (with a set for Leidschendam, Voorburg, Stompwijk, Wilsveen and Veur 1584 to 1811), municipal police, house research, and pupils of local schools. The site also has overviews of persons and addresses, a library and image collections. I did not run a search or check which of the digital sets are browse-only.
providers.triageNote: Opened the home page and the source-overview page on 2026-11-08; no source opened.

providers.name: Noord-Hollands Archief, Haarlem - Personen en databases
providers.what: The historical information centre for the province of North Holland, in Haarlem. Its persons page offers a name search with surname, particle, first name, role, place, source and period fields and an option for records that contain files, plus the same wildcard rules as other archives on the platform. The site also has archives, library, scan-on-request, building files and a notice that scan requests were temporarily down. The agenda mentions a genealogy consultation with the Dutch genealogical society. I did not run a search, so I cannot say which series are in the persons index.
providers.triageNote: Opened the home page and the persons page on 2026-11-08; no search run.

providers.name: Historisch Centrum Limburg (Maastricht and Heerlen)
providers.what: The regional historical centre for the Dutch province of Limburg, with reading rooms at Maastricht and Heerlen. The home page offers a search across archives, images, building plans, libraries, persons, regesten and films, and quick links to reserve archive items, request digitisation, see building files and consult the digital CABR (the central register of building files). I did not run a search or open the persons collection, so the series and years covered are unconfirmed.
providers.triageNote: Opened the home page on 2026-11-08 (the address www.rhcl.nl redirects here); persons not searched.

providers.name: AlleFriezen - persons from Friesland's municipal archives and Tresoar
providers.what: A portal that shows what the Frisian municipal archives, the regional historical centres of north-east Friesland and Leeuwarden, and Tresoar hold about people born, married or dying in the province from the 16th century to the early 1960s. It makes public civil-registry acts from 1811 available for the participating municipalities, and parts of the population registers, with many pre-1811 sources added. The search bar covers all sources at once and results can be sorted by columns such as first name, surname and role. I did not run a search, so I do not know how complete each municipality is.
providers.triageNote: Opened the home page on 2026-11-08; no search run.

providers.name: Alle Groningers (Groninger Archieven) - zoeken op naam
providers.what: The name index of Groninger Archieven for the province of Groningen. The help page describes a simple search on the home page and an advanced name search where one can search all fields at once, including occupations and places, and pick two persons who appear in the same record. Results can be narrowed by role (for example bride) and by registration type. A detail screen shows the registration image next to the data, with a button to download it as a JPEG. A section lets users browse sources, and the news mentions that prison registers are now online. I did not run a search, so the covered record types and years are unconfirmed.
providers.triageNote: Opened the home page and the search-help page on 2026-11-08; search not run. Browse-sources page returned only a title.

providers.name: Genealogie Online - gepubliceerde stambomen
providers.what: A Dutch site where researchers publish family trees and visitors search them; the home page counts 90 million persons. Publishing is free at a basic level, and the site suggests links to online scans of civil registry, church books and gravestones for the people in a tree. It carries a copyright warning that genealogical publications are protected even if the facts come from public archives. As user-submitted trees, entries are leads that need checking against registers. I did not run a search or see the paid levels.
providers.triageNote: Opened the home page on 2026-11-08; no search run, subscription tiers not read.

providers.name: CBG Centrum voor familiegeschiedenis (The Hague)
providers.what: The Dutch research centre for family history and heraldry. The home page offers direct searches in its collections: WieWasWie, the CBG collections, family coats of arms, the library and family names, and a page on consulting collections in person. News in November 2026 announces that WieWasWie, which is listed among its collections, has a new look and new way of presenting search results from 2 November. I did not run any search, so the contents of the collections are not described here.
providers.triageNote: Opened the home page on 2026-11-08. The existing wiewaswie row may be affected by the redesign (see notes).

providers.name: Archives départementales du Nord (Lille)
providers.what: The departmental archives of Nord have a portal whose consultation menu lists decennial tables, parish and civil-status registers, military registers, population censuses, tables of successions and absences with death cards, mortgage tables and registers, and cadastral plans. Each has its own page and search form (the registers page points to a form for parish and civil-status records; the military page to forms for the tables and cards of service records). A global search and a search by classification plan are also offered, and the portal shows login and registration links. I did not run a search, so I cannot say how much has images online or in which years.
providers.triageNote: Opened the home page and the registers, military-registers and successions pages on 2026-11-08; the search forms are script-driven and were not run. Not in the Atlas's departmental list (ad-*).

providers.name: Archives départementales du Doubs (Besançon)
providers.what: The departmental archives of Doubs, The site lists a state of holdings, search forms, research help sheets, and services including civil-status access with decennial tables. A news item announces 'État civil: tout est en ligne' with a celebratory programme, and other pages cover a history of the Lip company sources and the holdings of teacher-training colleges. The archives are at Planoise, Besançon. I did not open the civil-status pages in detail or run a search.
providers.triageNote: Opened the home page and the civil-status access page on 2026-11-08; forms not run. Not in the Atlas's departmental list (ad-*).

providers.name: Archives départementales d'Ille-et-Vilaine (Rennes)
providers.what: The departmental archives of Ille-et-Vilaine. The site's menus cover research by correspondence, reading-room use, research aids, copies, online digital resources, notarial and municipal holdings, and guidance for private people and families on depositing papers. One page lists unavailable holdings and communication periods for personal data. I opened only the menus, so I cannot say what civil-status or parish registers are online or how the name indexes work.
providers.triageNote: Opened the home page and the digital-resources page on 2026-11-08; page bodies were menus only. Not in the Atlas's departmental list (ad-*).

providers.name: Cercle de Généalogie Juive (France) - bases de données
providers.what: The first French Jewish genealogy association. Its databases page describes four resources: BECANE, civil-status extracts for North Africa from French foreign-ministry archives and Italian archives; BIKETTE, transcribed gravestones from Jewish cemeteries in Tunisia (7,513 records and over 8,300 photos in version 3.50); REGIE, the collected transcriptions and photographs by members from archives in France and abroad, such as the foreign ministry archives, Paris civil status and the Alliance Israélite Universelle; and a census of Alsace Jews of 1784. A multi-database search is offered, along with a resources guide for 33 countries. The home page notes that Salonica transcriptions in REGIE were being reloaded. I did not run a search.
providers.triageNote: Opened the home page and the databases page on 2026-11-08; no search run, membership terms not read.

providers.name: Cercle Généalogique d'Alsace (CGA)
providers.what: The Alsace genealogical society. Its front page has a global search for a name, first name or book title, and offers a 24-hour subscription to try the content without a long membership, in addition to full membership and donations. It also lists projects and events. The paid-access structure is visible; what the search returns, and which Alsace records are indexed, I did not see.
providers.triageNote: Opened the front page on 2026-11-08; no search run and subscription terms not read in full.

providers.name: Maitron - Dictionnaire biographique du mouvement ouvrier et social
providers.what: An online biographical dictionary of the French labour and social movement from the 19th century to the present. The home page counts 225,938 biographical notices and presents thematic corpora being added to, a heritage section with the historical notices that can no longer be edited, and news. The notices are for people of the workers' movement, such as union members and militants, and so cover only some families. I did not search or open a notice, so I do not know how detailed the family data are.
providers.triageNote: Opened the home page on 2026-11-08; no notice or search opened.

providers.name: Archivo Diocesano de Orihuela-Alicante - Archivo Digital
providers.what: The diocesan archive of Orihuela-Alicante. Its site offers a booking for reading-room visits, archive services and a 'digital archive' tool that lets researchers search the archive and ask for documents to be downloaded. It says the number of requests is high and replies can take longer than usual. I did not use the tool, so which sacramental books are included and whether it is free are not known.
providers.triageNote: Opened the home page on 2026-11-08; did not use the digital-archive tool.

providers.name: National Library and Archives
providers.what: Abu Dhabi body (Arabic site) combining the national archive and national library. Its site lists government archives, historical archives, private archives, an oral-history archive, an archival image gallery and publications, and offers a request-a-visit and a request-archival-material service. It says nothing about genealogy or family-history records, and the contents of the historical and private archives are not described on the pages opened.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Home page, /our-archive/ (lists Government, Historical, Private archives as menu entries with no description) and /contact-us/ (Abu Dhabi, P.O. Box 5884, no street address). Service pages under /services/nlaapp/ returned only a title or an error, so access terms and fees were not seen. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: Biblioteca Nacional Mariano Moreno
providers.what: Argentina's national library in Buenos Aires. Reading rooms listed include general, periodicals (hemeroteca), rare items (Sala del Tesoro), archives (Sala de Archivos), maps and photographs, and music. Entry is free with photo ID. Online catalogue, digital objects and digital exhibitions are offered. The pages opened do not mention genealogy, civil registers or family-history sources.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Home page (address Aguero 2502, catalogue at catalogo.bn.gov.ar) and /biblioteca/salas, which says entry to the library is free and lists the reading rooms. Access stays unsurveyed because the page states entry is free but not what is online. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: Azerbaijan National Library
providers.what: National library of Azerbaijan (Azerbaijani site). Offers an e-catalogue, e-databases, an Open Library, an electronic music library, reading halls and online ordering. Its e-periodicals section has well over 100 newspaper and journal titles in Azerbaijani and Russian, searchable by year, month and day; the page says upload is still in progress. No mention of genealogy or registers on the pages opened.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Home page (menu: catalogue ek.anl.az, /newspapers, /databases, reading halls, registration) and /newspapers (title list with date filters; coverage range not stated; no login notice seen). No street address given; coordinates from Wikidata (Baku).

providers.name: Nacionalna i univerzitetska biblioteka Bosne i Hercegovine
providers.what: National and University Library in Sarajevo. Special collections include old and rare books (four incunabula, Franciscan prints), about 1,000 mostly Arabic, Turkish and Persian codices plus archival collections (including documents of the Poljica Republic), maps, graphics and music. COBISS catalogue and digital collections (kolekcije.nub.ba) exist. Pages opened do not mention genealogy, registers or newspapers.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Home page and /specijalne-zbirke (collection descriptions; hours 07:30-16:00 weekdays; address Zmaja od Bosne 8B, 71000 Sarajevo). No access procedure for special collections stated on the page. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: KBR (Royal Library of Belgium)
providers.what: Belgium's national library in Brussels. Holds manuscripts, rare books, maps, prints, coins and the largest newspaper collection in Belgium: about 2,500 Belgian titles from the late 18th century (legal deposit since 1966), about 500 foreign titles, and the Gaston Mertens collection of 60,000+ specimens from about 1,650 municipalities up to 1948. Many titles are digitised in BelgicaPress. It does not describe genealogy or civil registers.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. /en/ home, /en/collections/newspapers/ (holdings above; part of BelgicaPress open remotely, full corpus needs a MyKBR login and is limited to teaching or scientific use; the page does not say whether it is free; originals read in the general reading room, up to 12 volumes reserved via the catalogue) and /en/getting-a-readers-card/ (age 16+, ID, paid at reception, price list separate). Bare kbr.be returned an empty body on first fetch. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: Народна библиотека "Иван Вазов" (Ivan Vazov National Library, Plovdiv)
providers.what: The Plovdiv library, Bulgaria's second largest. Named collections include a Bulgarian historical archive, Ottoman-Turkish documents, calligraphic schools, a secret book fund and an academician's personal library; manuscripts and photographs are in the NALIS digital repository. Has an online catalogue, digital library and a local-history (kraeznanie) department where full searches are paid. Pages opened do not mention genealogy.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Home page (after 301 to /index.php/bg/2009-09-04-08-21-01), the collections page (named collections, no sizes) and the virtual local-history page (answers about Plovdiv region within two working days, up to 5 results; full searches in the Local History department, room 26, paid per price list). No street address seen; coordinates from Wikidata. This is the Plovdiv regional library, not the Sofia national library.

providers.name: Национальная библиотека Беларуси (National Library of Belarus)
providers.what: Minsk national library with over 10.5 million items (15.4 million after the 2024 merger with the National Book Chamber), including printed works, manuscripts, early printed and rare books, maps, music and dissertations, plus a Belarusiana collection. Offers an electronic library, electronic and union catalogues, a press database and remote access with registration. The collections page does not mention genealogy or archival records.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Home page (address pr. Nezavisimosti 116, Minsk; weekday hours 10:00-21:00; elib.nlb.by electronic library and catalogues) and the collections page (figures above; manuscripts and rare-books section; no archival holdings described). Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: Belize National Library Service and Information System
providers.what: Runs the National Heritage Library in Belmopan (40,000+ books, reports, serials, microfilm; a National Collection of newspapers, maps, photographs and rare items, some from the mid-18th century), the Leo Bradley Library in Belize City and branches. Its newspaper page lists titles with years held (e.g. Amandala from 1969, Belize Times from 1956, The Angelus 1885-1903), format not stated. Use is on site with a microform reader; some digitising is under way. Genealogy and registers are not mentioned.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Home page, /newspapers-national-collection (title and year list, no consultation procedure) and /national-heritage-library-0 (Mountain View Blvd, Belmopan; Mon-Fri 9-7, Sat 9-1; materials used on site; microform reader; digitising rare books and images). Wikidata coordinates for this entity look inconsistent with Belmopan, so left null.

providers.name: Biblioteca Nacional de Chile
providers.what: Chile's national library in Santiago. Collections: Seccion Chilena (about 400,000 titles), Fondo General (about 350,000), Sala Medina (almost 35,000 colonial and 19th-century titles), about 7,000 journal titles, 19th-century-to-present newspapers (Periodicos y Microformatos), a Hemeroteca, and writer, music and oral-tradition archives. Online catalogue, Memoria Chilena and a digital library exist. No mention of genealogy or civil/parish registers on the pages opened.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Home page (address Libertador Bernardo O'Higgins 651; online membership; catalogue; Memoria Chilena; Biblioteca Nacional Digital), /colecciones-bibliograficas-y-documentales (figures above; consultation described only as catalogue search) and /hemeroteca (magazines, almanacs and official publications; oldest Chilean titles 1843). Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: Hong Kong Central Library
providers.what: The largest public library in Hong Kong, in Causeway Bay, run by Hong Kong Public Libraries. Its pages list a Reference Library, a Hong Kong Literature Room, a library catalogue, Hong Kong Memory and an online Old Hong Kong Newspapers collection (digitised selected major titles). It is a public library, not an archive, and the pages opened say nothing about genealogy or registers.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. The location page (66 Causeway Road; daily hours) and the general HKPL reference-collections overview (Old HK Newspapers, Special Collections 'mainly Hong Kong related', Digital Collection). The Old HK Newspapers page redirected to a Queue-it waiting room and was not followed, so titles, years and cost were not seen. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: National Library of China
providers.what: Per its collection overview (Dec 2025 figures): 46,145,326 items, including about 6.3 million special-collection items (maps, rare books, manuscripts, Dunhuang and Turfan materials, dissertations). Digital holdings include 5,741 digitised genealogies (jiapu) and 6,946 local gazetteers; physical genealogies and gazetteers together number 153,302 items. Its roots site, Chinese Roots Network (ouroots.nlc.cn, a joint project with the Macao Foundation), describes itself as a service on surname origins and genealogies for overseas Chinese: over 500 surname histories, over 2,000 genealogies and about 6,000 other documents to read, with a search by surname, genealogy title or locality and sign-in and registration. The Rare Book Library is stated closed since 2 April 2024.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08, pages opened in a browser. /web/dzzn/guotuziyuan/index.shtml gives the Dec 2025 counts; ouroots.nlc.cn (opened in a browser; a plain script fetch had been refused) states the roots-site scope above. Page does not state fees or whether genealogy images are free to the public, so access stays unsurveyed. Coordinates from Wikidata P625; address 33 Zhongguancun South Street, Haidian, Beijing.

providers.name: Biblioteka Nashonal Kòrsou (National Library of Curaçao)
providers.what: The library's site describes a public and national library at Schottegatweg Zuid 36, Willemstad, with children's, youth and adult sections, e-books, an online catalogue, and a National Documentation section. That section holds old newspapers, magazines, books and printed law decrees, and aims to keep every work published on Curaçao. The pages say nothing about genealogy or family-history records. Membership gives a library card.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage and /the-library/national-documentation/: the latter says it holds old newspapers, magazines, books and law decrees; no mention of genealogy and no access terms or fees for that section; opening hours differ between header and footer. Coordinates from Wikidata P625.

providers.name: Národní knihovna České republiky (National Library of the Czech Republic)
providers.what: Holds over 7.5 million documents: manuscripts (15,000+), incunabula (4,200+), old prints 1501-1800 (170,000+ volumes), maps, music, graphics, periodicals and an archive of its own and other fonds. The collections page does not mention genealogy or parish registers. The events listing shows a 'Genealogie pro každého' lecture series (one on soldiers in civil registers, 11 Nov 2026, free, reservation required). Catalogues and digital libraries are listed at /katalogy-databaze-digitalni-knihovny; address Mariánské nám. 5, Praha 1.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. nkp.cz redirects to www.nkp.cz. /o-knihovne/sbirky-a-fondy gives the holdings counts and says nothing on genealogy; the homepage lists the genealogy lecture and the price list /sluzby/cenik (not opened), so access stays unsurveyed. Coordinates from Wikidata P625.

providers.name: Arbeitsgemeinschaft Sammlung Deutscher Drucke (AG SDD)
providers.what: A cooperation of six libraries forming a 'distributed national library' of printed works of the German-speaking area from 1450 to the present, each responsible for a period: BSB Munich (1450-1600, chair), HAB Wolfenbuettel (1601-1700), SUB Goettingen (1701-1800), UB Frankfurt (1801-1870), Staatsbibliothek Berlin (1871-1912), Deutsche Nationalbibliothek (1913 on). The site is a web presence of the network (book of the month, acquisitions); it does not mention genealogy and gives no reading-room, catalogue or borrowing rules; those are with the member libraries.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage (ag-sdd.de) describes the six member libraries and period split; no address, no genealogy, no access terms on the page. It is a network, not a holding institution with its own premises, so no coordinates given.

providers.name: ZB MED - Information Centre for Life Sciences
providers.what: Specialist library for medicine, health, nutrition, environmental and agricultural sciences, with sites in Cologne (Gleueler Strasse 60) and Bonn. The homepage describes a digital library, the LIVIVO search portal, subscription databases, 30,000 e-books and e-journals via remote access with a virtual library card, and subito document delivery. It does not mention genealogy or family history; not a source for family records.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage zbmed.de: life-science literature services, addresses in Koeln and Bonn, virtual library card for the digital library; no genealogy content. Coordinates from Wikidata P625 (preferred value). deepLink is linked from the homepage, not opened.

providers.name: Det Kgl. Bibliotek (Royal Danish Library)
providers.what: The homepage's 'Find materiale' lists books, images, letters, maps, manuscripts, newspapers, folklore and more. Mediestream gives online access to historical newspapers, radio and TV; Digitale samlinger has online images, print, manuscripts, maps and rare books; the aerial-photo service Danmark set fra luften is also online. Printing, copying and scanning need a user account (Bliv bruger). Genealogy and parish registers are not mentioned on the pages read. Catalogue at soeg.kb.dk.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. kb.dk homepage and /find-materiale: categories Aviser, Kort, Haandskrifter, Breve etc., Mediestream and Digitale samlinger online; no genealogy mention; reading-room rules and fees not on those pages. The Aarhus State and University Library URL (statsbiblioteket.dk) now redirects here. Coordinates from Wikidata P625.

providers.name: Bibliotheque nationale d'Algerie (National Library of Algeria)
providers.what: The Arabic-language site describes the legal-deposit library for Algerian publications (national bibliography), with a manuscripts and rare-documents section (manuscript map, watermark studies), an audiovisual section, a digital library, and an online catalogue (OPAC, national and union catalogues). Services include lending, reference by post/phone/email, and photocopying or digitising of manuscripts and rare books that cannot leave the library. Registration for membership is online. It says nothing about genealogy or civil/parish records.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage biblionat.dz (Arabic): lists the sections above and opening hours (Sat 9-18, Sun-Thu 9-20); no physical address and no genealogy mention. The manuscripts site link is from the homepage, not opened. Coordinates from Wikidata P625.

providers.name: Biblioteca Nacional del Ecuador Eugenio Espejo (Casa de la Cultura Ecuatoriana)
providers.what: The library site of the Casa de la Cultura Ecuatoriana in Quito (Av. 6 de Diciembre N16-224, Edificio de los Espejos, 2nd floor; Mon-Fri 8:30-17:00). Collections listed: language and literature, social sciences, pure sciences, arts, children's and youth, and an 'Institutional Memory' collection of the Casa's own publications. Koha online catalogue, a digital repository and database list; users register to borrow. No mention of genealogy or civil records.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage biblioteca.casadelacultura.gob.ec: subject collections, Koha OPAC, repository repositorio.casadelacultura.gob.ec, address and hours, registration form for borrowing; nothing on genealogy or fees. Coordinates from Wikidata P625 (low precision).

providers.name: Real Biblioteca (Royal Library of Madrid)
providers.what: The Spanish royal library (Patrimonio Nacional). Site describes its digital platform Real Biblioteca Digital (incunabula, selected manuscripts, drawings, American manuscripts), the IBIS catalogue (also covering royal patronage convents and the royal sites of El Pardo and Aranjuez), and databases on bindings, ex libris and ownership marks. The researchers' reading room is by appointment requested by email, with remote consultation preferred. Genealogy is not discussed; no postal address shown on the page.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage realbiblioteca.es: RBD, IBIS catalogue, specialised databases, reading room by appointment; page does not mention genealogy. Online images are partial (selected items) so access stays unsurveyed. Coordinates from Wikidata P625; deepLink is linked from the homepage, not opened.

providers.name: FSM Office of National Archives, Culture and Historic Preservation (NACH)
providers.what: Federated States of Micronesia national office for archives, culture and historic preservation. Its research page sets out a permit process for anyone doing research in the FSM: a proposal and data-sharing agreement emailed at least 120 days ahead, a fee, and decisions 90-120 days after receipt; oral histories may not be AI-processed without State permission. The pages read describe no archive holdings, no genealogy service and no reading-room access.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage nach.gov.fm (navigation; no address) and /research/ (permit rules). Neither page describes holdings or genealogy. No coordinates on the site or in Wikidata, so none given.

providers.name: Bibliothèque nationale et universitaire de Strasbourg (Bnu)
providers.what: Academic reference library for Alsace holding nearly 4 million documents, from cuneiform tablets to digital material, with Oriental manuscripts, about 2,120 incunabula, law and social-science collections since 1871, and archives collected since 1871 (not itemised). Runs Numistral, a digital heritage library of Alsatian collections. The pages say nothing about genealogy, parish or civil registers; a family historian would use its catalogue and Numistral for Alsatian printed and digitised material.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage (www.bnu.fr) lists Numistral, collections, registration, hours and catalogue (biblio.bnu.fr/opac); /fr/services-et-collections/nos-collections says 'près de 4 millions de documents' and responsibility for Alsatian documentary heritage; no genealogy or registers mentioned. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: National Science Library (ეროვნული სამეცნიერო ბიბლიოთეკა)
providers.what: Tbilisi science library with an OPAC (books, articles, patents, newspapers and journals), subscribed scientific databases, and digital repositories OpenLibrary (books, monographs, manuscripts from its holdings), OpenJournals and OpenScience. Reader registration is through the catalogue. The site says nothing about genealogy or civil/church registers; it is a scholarly library rather than a family-records source.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage sciencelib.ge describes OPAC (opac.sciencelib.ge), scientific databases, OpenLibrary/OpenScience/OpenJournals, reader registration; address M. Alexidze St., II lane No. 3, Tbilisi; genealogy not mentioned. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: Nunatta Atuagaateqarfia (Public and National Library of Greenland)
providers.what: Central public library of Greenland in Nuuk; the site says Groenlandica (Nuussuaq) is Greenland's national library. Pages cover Greenlandic literature and authors, legal deposit (pligtaflevering), digital offers (eReolen e-books, Filmstriben), borrowing, and print/copy/scan. The pages opened do not mention genealogy, archives or local history.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage katak.gl/da: Nunatta Atuagaateqarfia in Nuuk, Groenlandica as national library at Manutooq 1, Nuussuaq; /da/digitale-tilbud lists eReolen, Filmstriben and a category 'Bøger, arkiver og tidsskrifter' with no detail; no genealogy or local history mentioned. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: National Library of Greece (Εθνική Βιβλιοθήκη της Ελλάδος)
providers.what: Collections: general, special, lending, and electronic/digital. Digital Collections hold about 900 items (about 700 manuscripts, rare books, maps) free to view; a Digital Newspaper Collection of over 270,000 pages from seven titles (e.g. Eleftheria 1944-67, Empros 1896-1969, Makedonia 1911-81, Rizospastis 1917-83) with OCR; Istorima has over 18,000 oral histories. Genealogy is not mentioned; newspapers and oral histories could help local-history context.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage nlg.gr and /collection/ilektronikes-amp-psifiakes-sylloges/: digitised manuscripts, books, maps and Istorima 'freely available for viewing'; e-books and school databases need registration for remote use; the page does not state whether newspapers are free. Genealogy not mentioned. Access set to mixed on that basis. Coordinates from Wikidata (the SNFCC seat).

providers.name: Nemzeti Audiovizuális Archívum (NAVA)
providers.what: Hungarian national audiovisual archive of public-broadcaster output: channels such as M1, Duna TV and Kossuth Rádió, MTV news archives 1988-2005 (some years missing), and special and thematic collections (1956, the 1867 Compromise, World War I, religion, education). Some programmes are free access online; fuller access is through NAVA-pont member institutions or a personal registration. No genealogy or family-records material; only indirect historical context.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage nava.hu lists free-access programmes (/szabad-musorok/), special collections, thematic collections, NAVA-pont institutional access and personal registration (/nava-pont-regisztracio/); genealogy not mentioned. Wikidata has no coordinates and the page opened gave no address, so 'at' is null.

providers.name: Országos Széchényi Könyvtár (National Széchényi Library)
providers.what: Hungary's national library, Budapest. Collections include periodicals, manuscripts, early printed works, posters and ephemera, maps, theatre history, music, photographs, audiovisual material and an Oral History Archive. Digital library: MEK, OSZK Digital Library, EPA periodicals, Digital Image Archive, E-corvinák; catalogues NEKTÁR, MNB and MOKKA. A reader registration page exists. The homepage does not mention genealogy; Hungaricana is not mentioned.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage www.oszk.hu menus: collections (/torzsgyujtemenyek), registration (/beiratkozas), opening hours Tue-Thu 10-18, Fri-Sat 9-19, digital library (/digitalis_konyvtar), NEKTÁR; genealogy not mentioned. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: National Library of Ireland
providers.what: Collects Ireland's recorded memory: books, serials, newspapers, manuscripts, photographs, prints, maps, ephemera, web and born-digital archives. Has a free Family History Service (help finding sources, research room with computers and genealogy reference works, email help for remote users; not a full research service) and links to the online Catholic Parish Registers (registers.nli.ie). A free Reader's Card is needed for the Family History Room.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage nli.ie: Family History section, Catholic Parish Registers link, banner 'Apply for a free Reader's Card'; /family-history/family-history-service: service is free, reader's ticket via rtickets.nli.ie, appointments by email, no specific record collections listed. Pages did not say whether register images are free online, so access left unsurveyed. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: National Medical Library (NML-ERMED Consortium)
providers.what: The URL is the NML-ERMED Consortium site (Electronic Resources in Medicine), run from the National Medical Library, New Delhi, under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. It provides 242 e-journals from five publishers plus e-books to about 70 member government institutions by IP address, free of membership fee. It is a medical e-journal service and says nothing about family-history records.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage ermed.in describes the consortium, members (about 70 institutions, no fee, IP access), publishers and journals; no genealogy; the site covers the consortium, not the library's own holdings or visiting. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: Landsbókasafn Íslands - Háskólabókasafn (National and University Library of Iceland)
providers.what: Keeps 'everything published in Iceland' as national library and serves University of Iceland study and research. The homepage lists journals and newspapers (links to Tímarit.is), Bækur.is, web archive (Vefsafn), open-access research, electronic databases, and special collections (Sérsöfn). Genealogy is not mentioned on the page; Tímarit.is is a linked digitised-press site (not described there).
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage landsbokasafn.is: sections on timarit-og-dagblod, vefsafn, sersofn, thjonusta, afgreidslutimi; genealogy and manuscripts not described. Library card details given only for new University students. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: Biblioteca Nazionale Braidense
providers.what: Milan national library, Via Brera 28, with over 1.5 million volumes. Named collections include the Manzoni manuscripts and correspondence (about 5,000 letters), Raccolta Drammatica, Haller, the Sommariva photographic studio archive 1904-1973 and Fondo Correnti. Digital resources and an online catalogue (opac.braidense.it) exist. Open to those over 16 with photo ID and codice fiscale; consultation and loans need registration. Genealogical records are not mentioned.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage bibliotecabraidense.org: '1.500.000 di volumi', fondi, risorse digitali, access conditions (over 16, photo ID, codice fiscale, registration), address Via Brera 28; no genealogy. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: Alphabetica (ICCU - Istituto Centrale per il Catalogo Unico)
providers.what: The url (www.sbn.it/en-US/web/alphabetica/) now redirects to opac.sbn.it Alphabetica, a portal from ICCU (Italian Ministry of Culture) for exploring cultural heritage in Italian libraries: books, manuscripts, music, periodicals, maps, graphics, audio/video, and a libraries map. Links to OPAC SBN, EDIT16 and Manus Online catalogues. It is a catalogue portal, not a holder of records; genealogy is not mentioned. Login and subscribe options exist; what needs an account is not stated.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Page opac.sbn.it/en-US/web/alphabetica/ (after 301 from www.sbn.it) describes Alphabetica by ICCU/MiC with sections for books, manuscripts, libraries map, and network links to OPAC SBN, EDIT16, Manus Online. Entity is Italian National Libraries / SBN network; no address read, so 'at' is null.

providers.name: Kenya National Library Service
providers.what: Kenya's national library service. Its site describes a national documentary heritage collection built partly through legal deposit and recorded in the Kenya National Bibliography, a rare-collections page, a collections search, e-journals and open/subscribed e-resources, digitization, and interlibrary loans. Based at Maktaba Kuu, Upper Hill, Nairobi. The site says nothing about genealogy, archives or newspapers as holdings.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage lists /legal-deposit/, /kenya-national-bibliography/, /rare-collections/, /search-our-collections/, /e-journals/, /interlibrary-loans/, /digitization/; address Maktaba Kuu Building, Upper Hill, Nairobi. /rare-collections/ names famous world items as examples and says access is via digital copies and guided routes through library networks (does not say these are held by KNLS). No fees or membership terms stated. No coordinates certain: at set null.

providers.name: National Assembly Library of Korea
providers.what: South Korea's legislative library. The site describes a catalogue (dl.nanet.go.kr), parliamentary and legal information, national bibliographies, e-books, a Digital Library, and a Records Information Service covering National Assembly Archives and records management. Reading hours 09:00-21:00 weekdays, 09:00-17:00 weekends (English page). It says nothing about genealogy or family-history records; its collection is parliamentary and academic in focus.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Korean homepage: catalogue search, /libaryuseinfo/ visitor pages, /libintroduce/etc/libDataStatusView.do holdings statistics, a notice that the Digital Information Center reading rooms are closed 2026-10-25 to 2026-11-22. English page /english/main.do lists Parliamentary Information, Legal Information, National Bibliographies, Records Information Service (National Assembly Archives). No mention of genealogy (jokbo). Address 1 Uisadang-daero, Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: National Library and Documentation Services Board
providers.what: Sri Lanka's national library body; the National Library of Sri Lanka at No. 14 Independence Avenue, Colombo 07, describes itself as a research and reference library of last resort. Listed collections include Sri Lanka, palm-leaf, periodical, newspaper, thesis, folklore, government publications, maps and microfilm, with national catalogues and a National Digital Library and Repository. Open Mon-Fri 8:30-16:15. The pages say nothing about genealogy.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage is only a name, logo and links (/NLDSB, /NLSL, ISBN site). /NLSL lists the collections above, the National Library Catalogue, National Union Catalogue, National Digital Library, hours, address and reader@ contact. No mention of genealogy, fees or what is online. /NLDSB not opened. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: Lietuvos nacionalinė Martyno Mažvydo biblioteka (Martynas Mažvydas National Library of Lithuania)
providers.what: Lithuania's national library, Gedimino pr. 51, Vilnius. The site lists a rare books and manuscripts reading room, a media reading room with periodicals, the LIBIS union catalogue and national bibliography, a database of Lithuanian periodical articles, scanned publications, the e.paveldas heritage portal and Europeana. It says nothing about genealogy or parish records.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage links /erdves/skaityklos/retu-knygu-ir-rankrasciu-skaitykla, /istekliai/katalogai/bibliografine-lietuvos-periodines-spaudos-straipsniu-baze, /istekliai/duomenu-bazes/lietuvos-kulturos-paveldo-portalas-e-paveldas, /istekliai/mokslo-ir-enciklopediju-leidybos-centro-istekliai/skenuoti-leidiniai, /paslaugos/lankytojui/registracija-ir-aptarnavimas. Genealogy not mentioned. Fees not stated. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: Bibliothèque nationale du Luxembourg (BnL)
providers.what: Luxembourg's national library, 37D avenue John F. Kennedy, Luxembourg. Holds about 1.8 million documents: Luxembourgish and other heritage and research collections, rare books, medieval manuscripts, maps, posters, postcards, ephemera. Digitized Luxembourg documents are at eluxemburgensia.lu, and the Lëtzebuerger Journal 1948-2020 is stated to be free to access remotely. General catalogue a-z.lu. The pages say nothing about genealogy.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Pages relied on: /fr/fonds.html (about 1.8 million documents), /fr/offres-numeriques/eluxemburgensia.html, /fr/a-la-une/actualites/communiques/2026/letzebuerger-journal.html (Journal 1948-Dec 2020 free remotely), /fr/services/inscription.html, /fr/support/aide-contact/horaires-acces.html. Fees not stated; access left unsurveyed. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: Latvijas Nacionālā bibliotēka (National Library of Latvia)
providers.what: Latvia's national library, Mukusalas iela 3, Riga. Collections include rare books and manuscripts, maps, music, art, audiovisual, a Letonika collection and the legal-deposit archive copy. Periodika.lv offers free full-text OCR search of 1,500+ Latvian-related newspaper and magazine titles from the 18th century on, with page download as PDF/JPEG. Also a Digital Library, scanned card catalogues and a Primo finder. The site does not mention genealogy.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage /lv/krajums/ lists the collections; /lv/periodika/ says Periodika.lv is free to browse, full-text OCR searchable, 18th century to present, 1,500+ titles, pages downloadable as PDF/JPEG. Also /lv/digitala-biblioteka/, /lv/skenetie-katalogi/, /lv/klusti-par-lasitaju/. Genealogy not mentioned. Periodika.lv free online per that page; library access overall left unsurveyed. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: Libyan Center for Archives and Historical Studies
providers.what: The page (on ARSHEEF, a third-party guide to archives of the region, not the centre's own site) says the centre began as a repository on the Libyan anti-colonial struggle and has widened to pre-modern manuscripts, books and magazines, including records of Libya in the Ottoman period and earlier. Mostly held as scans; microfilm currently inaccessible. No online catalogue: printed catalogues are consulted in person in Tripoli. Genealogy and civil registers are not mentioned.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. /libyan-center-for-archives-and-historical-studies on arsheef.org says it is open to the public most days 9am-4pm at the corner of Munaydar and al-Baydha Street, Tripoli; Arabic likely needed; no online catalogue; belongings in lockers. The ARSHEEF /about and /digitized-collections pages do not describe this centre. The source is a visitor guide, not the institution; the Wikidata entity has no coordinates.

providers.name: Médiathèque de Monaco (Médiathèque Caroline; Louis Notari Library)
providers.what: Monaco's public library. Its heritage fund (Fonds & Collections page) holds archives and books on the history of Monaco and nearby regions (manuscripts, photographs, maps, posters), including the communal archives of Monaco and personal papers, plus legal deposit of Monegasque publications and rare books. It has digitised six old Monaco press titles (1897-1963) searchable online by full text. Genealogy and civil-status records are not mentioned.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. /fonds-collections.aspx lists the Fonds régional (communal archives of Monaco, personal fonds, old press), Dépôt légal and Fonds précieux; it does not mention genealogy or civil status. /default/presse-ancienne.aspx lists Le Petit Monégasque 1897-1926, La Gazette de Monaco et de Monte-Carlo 1926-1934, Le Journal de la Corniche 1902-1913, La Revue de la Riviera illustrée 1907-1920, Rives d'Azur 1920-1963, Monaco Revue 1912, with full-text search; the page does not say if access is free. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: Biblioteca Naţională a Republicii Moldova
providers.what: The site lists an online catalogue (BNRM Online and SIBIMOL), traditional card catalogues, a collections page, old and rare books, publications, the Moldavica digital library and the MOLDLIS repository. The collections page describes mainly books and scientific periodicals, plus a research fund built from a 2011 Romanian legal-deposit gift. It does not mention genealogy, registers or newspapers. Address: Str. 31 August 1989 nr. 78-A, Chisinau.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage and /?page_id=4063 (Colectii): catalogue links catalog.bnrm.md/opac and moldavica.bnrm.md; the collections page covers books, reference tools, dissertations and periodicals and says nothing about genealogy, rare books or manuscripts. Hours listed on the homepage (Mon-Thu 9:00-19:30, Fri closed, Sat-Sun 9:00-17:30). Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: Nacionalna biblioteka Crne Gore "Đurđe Crnojević"
providers.what: Collections listed: main fund, Montenegrina, old and rare books, manuscripts and archival materials (18th-19th-century letters, personal and official documents, court judgments, photographs, postcards), maps, music, serials, bequests and a digital library (dlib.me). COBISS e-catalogues are online. Genealogical records, family papers and parish or civil registers are not mentioned. Reading rooms in Cetinje; membership (annual, monthly or three-day) required, prices in a separate PDF.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage lists collections; /me/kolekcije/rukopisi-i-arhivalije describes manuscripts and correspondence of rulers and writers, not registers; /me/za-korisnike gives membership terms and reading rooms (Bulevar crnogorskih junaka 163, Cetinje); fees not stated on the page. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: National and University Library "St. Kliment of Ohrid"
providers.what: The homepage describes a COBISS e-catalogue (410,000+ records as of 2013) of books, maps, recordings, journals and newspapers. The Collections page lists rare books, over 33,000 manuscript titles, an Archaeographic Center, oriental studies, maps, music, theses and microforms, with newspapers held among serials. Genealogy is not mentioned. Address: Bul. Goce Delchev 6, Skopje.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage (address, COBISS catalogue) and /?page_id=1967 (collections: rare books, manuscripts over 33,000 titles, serials/newspapers in general fund); neither mentions genealogy or registers. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: National Library of Mongolia
providers.what: The site mentions an online catalogue, a national periodicals database, an article database, a section on sources in Mongolian script, a documentary-heritage department and wooden-printing-block project, and a Tibetan Buddhist digital library. It says nothing about genealogy or registers (the 'registration' page is for reader sign-up). Main building in Ulaanbaatar with listed winter and summer hours.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage only: links to ecatalog.nationallibrary.mn, sonin.nationallibrary.mn (periodicals), the Mongolian-script sources page and the documentary-heritage items; no genealogy mention. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: National Library of Maldives
providers.what: The homepage offers an online catalogue (Liberty OPAC) for loans and reservations, downloads including the national bibliography, e-resources and access to the National Digital Library of India by registration, study spaces and a children's library. It does not describe Maldivian heritage collections, manuscripts or newspapers, and says nothing about genealogy or registers.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage listing OPAC (opac.nlm.gov.mv), downloads (national bibliography), e-resources link, opening hours; the e-resources link itself was not opened. Collections not described. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: National Library Service of Malawi
providers.what: The homepage describes a lending library network service (membership by form; fees listed in kwacha), a computer lab, children's library, mobile library and e-resources. The About page says only 'Content Coming Soon'. No holdings, legal deposit, Malawiana or genealogy are described. Postal address: P.O. Box 30314, Lilongwe 3.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage (hours Mon-Fri 8:30-17:00, Sat 8:30-12:30; membership K2,500 adults in cities, K500 rural) and /about/ (placeholder). Holdings not described; nothing on genealogy. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: National Library of Nigeria
providers.what: Aims to collect all published materials in Nigeria, works by Nigerians abroad and works about Nigeria, with a Legal Deposit department, branches in 32 states and the FCT, an OPAC, the National Bibliography, a Virtual Library, a National Repository, and an Index to Nigeria Newspapers with a Newspapers & Magazines Locator. Genealogy and registers are not mentioned. Headquarters address given in Abuja.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage only; the newspaper index and locator pages were linked but not opened. Address on page: Sanusi Dantata House, Plot 274, CBD, Garki, Abuja. The Wikidata coordinates (7.38, 3.87, near Ibadan) do not match that address, so none are given.

providers.name: National Library of Nigeria, Kwara State Branch
providers.what: A blog of the Kwara State branch in Ilorin, saying it began in 1980 at 2 Offa Road. Posts cover a 2014 readership campaign, exhibition and a school excursion. It has catalogue pages but their contents were not shown, and holdings are not described. Genealogy and registers are not mentioned. Blog appears dated and may not be current.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Blogspot home page (mobile view): activity posts and the 1980 Offa Road history; no collections list, hours or genealogy. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: Biblioteca Nacional Rubén Darío
providers.what: The site gives a short history (opened to the public on 1 June 1882 with a founding collection of about 5,000 titles) and pages for the ISBN agency and ISBN registration. It does not describe current holdings, periodicals, manuscripts, a digital library or a catalogue, and says nothing about genealogy or registers.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage: history text and links (Quienes Somos, Agencias de ISBN, Buscar, Registro ISBN); the linked pages were not opened. No holdings or address given. Coordinates from Wikidata.

providers.name: Tibi - Biblioteket for tilrettelagt litteratur
providers.what: Tibi (the successor site of nlb.no) is a library service run by the National Library of Norway that makes and lends audiobooks, e-books and Braille books for people who cannot read printed text because of disability or illness. Borrowing needs membership. The site says nothing about genealogy, archives or historical records; not a family-history source.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. nlb.no redirects (301) to tibi.no. Homepage: Tibi is a service of Nasjonalbiblioteket serving readers with print disabilities; links /hvem-kan-lane/, /bli-laner/, /tilbudet-vart/. Visiting address Observatoriegata 1b, Oslo. No genealogy mention. Coordinates not certain, left null.

providers.name: Norsk Folkemuseum
providers.what: Open-air and cultural-history museum on Bygdoy, Oslo. Its collections page lists objects, photographs, archives, a library, film and sound; online via DigitaltMuseum (objects, photos), Arkivportalen (its archives), Oria (library catalogue). Library and archive open by appointment Tue and Thu 10-15; researchers and private individuals may request items. The site does not mention genealogy or person-records.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage (Museumsveien 10, Bygdoy, Oslo) and /Samlingene: lists DigitaltMuseum, Arkivportalen, Digitalarkivet, Oria, Minner.no, and by-appointment access via post@norskfolkemuseum.no. It is a museum, not a national archive as the input kind suggested. Coordinates not certain, left null.

providers.name: Nepal National Library
providers.what: National library under Nepal's Ministry of Education and Sports, at Sanothimi, Bhaktapur. The site lists a library catalogue (catalog.nnl.gov.np), an e-library repository (archive.nnl.gov.np), publications and a reader entry registration portal. Office hours Mon-Fri. The site does not mention genealogy or manuscripts.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. Homepage (nnl.gov.np): address Sanothimi Bhaktapur, catalogue and e-library links, library entry registration portal and office hours. Coordinates from Wikidata Q619789.

providers.name: National Library of Pakistan
providers.what: National library under the National Heritage and Culture Division. The homepage offers a catalogue search (title, author, subject, DDC, ISBN, year) and pages for new arrivals and a children's library. providers.name: Archivo General de la Nación
providers.what: Dominican national archive. Its services list (23 items) includes textual documents, a photo library, oral sources, audiovisual material, a digital newspaper archive, Dominican daily press, a map library, the AGN library catalogue, digital funds and collections, a Dominican digital library (over 16,000 books, free), document certification, reference/consultation/reproduction, and catalogues on Santo Domingo women in the 17th-18th centuries, Trujillo-era victims, and residence permits. The 'Textual Documents' page describes a portal of records and images of public and private paper collections, cost stated as free, delivered online, with access governed by Law 481-08. Reception hours 8:00-15:00 Mon-Fri, phone 809-362-1111. The pages opened do not name parish or civil registers.

providers.name: National Library of Finland
providers.what: Finland's oldest and largest scientific library (roots in the Turku Academy Library, 1640), at Unioninkatu 36, Helsinki. Collections come from legal deposit, purchase, exchange and donation: books, periodicals, small print, recordings, maps, images, manuscripts and some archive material. The collections page links to digi.kansalliskirjasto.fi (digitized material), Finna, Doria and Melinda, none opened. Materials from the national collection, manuscript collections and pre-1900 publications are for reading-room use only. The pages opened say nothing about genealogy or parish registers.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08 in a browser. /en/collections (history, content, links to digi, Finna, Doria; reading-room-only rule for national collection, manuscripts and pre-1900 items) and /en/using-library/visiting-library (visitor rules, reading rooms, free wi-fi, free cloakroom, free exhibitions). Cookie banner not accepted. No statement of fees for research or of what images are online; access left unsurveyed.

providers.name: The National Library of Israel
providers.what: Home page counts of items: 4.5 million books, 2.5 million photographs, 106,141 newspapers, 609,809 manuscripts, 12,167 maps, 1,418,350 archives, 120,000 recordings, plus posters, videos and piyutim. The Archives Department holds over a thousand personal archives (writers, rabbis, Zionist leaders, scientists and others), some institutional and community archives, and photograph, postcard, ketubbot and poster collections; most have finding aids, and archives catalogued in Aleph are searchable online. A 'Genealogy - Tracing Family Roots' page is a set of first steps pointing to outside sites (JewishGen, Yad Vashem database, MyHeritage, Geni); it does not describe NLI-held registers. Reading rooms require a personal reader card.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08 in a browser. /en (item counts; Library Card; visitor information), /en/at-your-service/genealogy (research steps pointing to JewishGen, Yad Vashem, MyHeritage, Geni), /en/at-your-service/who-we-are/collections/archives-collection (personal and some community archives, finding aids, Aleph catalogue). providers.name: Lietuvos vyriausiojo archyvaro tarnyba (Office of the Chief Archivist of Lithuania)
providers.what: Central state office that oversees Lithuania's archives (Mindaugo g. 8, Vilnius; 9 subordinate institutions listed). Its own site is mainly administrative (news, services price list, structure). Useful links from its home page: the Electronic Archive Information System (EAIS), Diaspora Archive, Electronic Archive of Names (lyapavardes.archyvai.lt), virtual exhibitions, a digital images archive of the Lithuanian Special Archives, a maps portal and ePaveldas. The Electronic Archive of Names indexes personal names in Soviet security-service and Communist Party fonds (deportation, arrest, resistance, emigration), gives fond/inventory/case numbers, and says digitised documents can be read free in the EAIS reading room; copies and searches are paid. It does not present parish registers.

providers.name: National Transportation Library
providers.what: US federal library established 1998 (TEA-21) and administered by the Bureau of Transportation Statistics in the US Department of Transportation. It provides access to transportation information, a digital repository (ROSA P) of DOT research, reference services, and a clearinghouse for federal transportation data. The About page says the DOT headquarters library closed on 1 Oct 2020 and public documents in its physical collection are being digitised into the repository. It is a subject (transport) library; the pages opened say nothing about genealogy, vital records or personal papers.

Cost and online-image access for any records not stated; access left unsurveyed. Little genealogical relevance.

providers.name: Biblioteca Nacional Aruba
providers.what: Aruba's national library (the http address redirects to https://www.bibliotecanacional.aw/pages/). Its Arubiana/Caribiana department describes a national collection of books, documents, newspapers, video and photographs by or about Aruba, an 'old' collection of books and documents dating from before 1600 onward, Antillean/Caribbean/Surinamese material, government publications (annual reports, parliamentary proceedings, Landscourant Aruba), local periodicals, and a digital collection (e.g. Arubaansche Courant 1948-1967 on library computers). Reading is on site. The page is silent on civil or church registers or a genealogy service. Site pages return no text to scrapers, so it was read from screenshots.

providers.name: Biblioteca Nacional Pedro Henríquez Ureña
providers.what: Central library of the Dominican State, responsible for collecting, preserving and disseminating the country's bibliographic heritage, mainly the written work of Dominican authors, and for the national network of public libraries. The pages read say nothing about civil or parish registers or a genealogy service.

providers.name: National Poetry Library
providers.what: Describes itself as housing the world's largest public collection of modern poetry; founded by the Arts Council in 1953, at the Southbank Centre (Level 5, Royal Festival Hall, London) since 1988. Says it is free to join across the UK and is London's only space dedicated to poetry study. Open Tuesday 12-6pm, Wednesday-Sunday 12-8pm, closed Monday. Pages cover joining, find/reserve/renew, events, online poetry. It is a specialist poetry collection; the page says nothing about registers, genealogy or local-history records.

providers.name: National Library of Kuwait
providers.what: Kuwait's national library, run by the National Council for Culture, Arts and Letters. Its history page traces it to a 1913 public library and says that by 1979 it held over 50,000 books and volumes, 6000+ periodicals and rare manuscripts. Services: OPAC search and reference, online databases, copyright registration, ISBN agency, photocopying and scanning, hall rental. Site menus also list a National Bibliography, a Digital Library, theses index and a Kuwait libraries portal. Nothing read mentions genealogy or civil or church registers.

providers.name: Nasjonalarkivet
providers.what: The Norwegian National Archives (Riksarkivet and the regional state archives, with Norsk helsearkiv and Samisk arkiv). Site is in Norwegian. providers.name: Biblioteca nazionale centrale di Firenze
providers.what: National Central Library of Florence, a public library run by the Italian Ministry of Culture. Its About Us page says it gathers Italian publications on any medium by legal deposit, donation or acquisition, and produces the Italian National Bibliography. The Reference Department page describes the historical core (Magliabechiana and Palatina libraries) and physical card catalogues: author/title (1886-1983 legal deposit, acquisitions to 1988), subject, periodicals (1874-1989), maps, engravings, 16th-century works; the Palatina catalogue is digitised. The pages seen say nothing about parish registers, civil records or genealogy; it is a printed-book library, not a records archive. Reproduction requests go through an online form, not by telephone.

providers.name: Slovak National Library (Slovenská národná knižnica)
providers.what: National library in Martin. Collects, preserves and makes available printed and electronic documents published in Slovakia, in Slovak, by Slovak authors or about Slovakia. Online catalogue (books, journals, newspapers, manuscripts), the DIKDA digital library and archive of digitised books, journals, newspapers and manuscripts, a catalogue of old prints 1477-1830, and a union catalogue of Slovak libraries. Research projects include a list of coats-of-arms charters (with the Slovak Genealogical-Heraldic Society) and work on regional families. The pages read do not mention parish registers or civil records; it is a library, not a records archive. Reading rooms: five.

providers.name: National Library of Tunisia (Bibliothèque nationale de Tunisie)
providers.what: National library of Tunisia. Online: a general catalogue, and Khaldouniya Digital, a portal of digitised Tunisian written heritage. Reader services include reproduction and digitisation at set rates, subscription options and legal deposit. providers.name: National Library and Information System Authority (NALIS)

providers.name: Österreichisches Staatsarchiv
providers.what: Austria's federal state archives, Vienna: more than 350 shelf-km, over 1,000 years of history, civil and military records of federal government and predecessors. Departments: Haus-, Hof- und Staatsarchiv (monarchy to WWI), Allgemeines Verwaltungsarchiv and Finanz- und Hofkammerarchiv, Kriegsarchiv (personnel records of officers, NCOs and enlisted men c. 1740-1918; field files from the 16th century; military parish registers), Archiv der Republik (federal records from 1918). Records are generally closed 30 years. The site has family-research guidance pages and the Archivregister directory of Austrian archives. It is a federal archive: other bodies such as Parliament keep their own.

This branch page gives address and hours but not its own holdings.

providers.name: Rijksarchief te Brugge (State Archives in Bruges)
providers.what: Branch of the State Archives of Belgium. The national genealogist page names civil status and church (parish) registers (births/baptisms, marriages, deaths), notarial deeds, censuses, aldermen's and judicial archives; civil and church registers over 100 years old are viewable online free, with about 25,000 parish registers and a growing number of civil registers searchable (digitisation incomplete). Registers under 100 years are not held. Reading rooms are free with a free reader card; some records under 30 years or with personal data need a written request. This branch page gives its address but not its own holdings.

providers.name: Schweizerische Nationalbibliothek (Swiss National Library)
providers.what: Swiss national library in Bern. It collects Helvetica (texts, images and sound relating to Switzerland) and includes the Graphische Sammlung (prints, posters, photographs, postcards), the Swiss Literary Archives (20th/21st-century literary estates and author libraries, founded 1991) and the Swiss National Sound Archive. Its catalogues page lists HelveticAll, Helveticat (many newspapers and magazines), e-Helvetica, HelveticArchives and links to digitised newspapers (e-newspaperarchives.ch) and journals (e-periodica.ch). The pages opened do not mention genealogy, parish or civil registers; a family historian would use it for Swiss books, newspapers, posters and photographs rather than for personal records. Closed 30 Oct to 29 Nov 2026 for a move.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. /snl/de/home.html (Helvetica, literary archive, opening hours Mon-Fri 9-18, closure for move, address Monbijoustrasse 74 from 30 Nov 2026); /de/uber-uns (Graphische Sammlung, Literaturarchiv founded 1991, Nationalphonothek); /de/kataloge (catalogue list, most online; no pricing stated; genealogy not mentioned). Coordinates are Wikidata P625 and may be the pre-move address.

providers.name: Deutsche Nationalbibliothek (Frankfurt am Main)
providers.what: Germany's national library, one library on two sites (Frankfurt am Main and Leipzig). Statutory collection of all publications in text, image and sound published in Germany since 1913, plus German-language works abroad, translations of German works, foreign works about Germany, and printed works by German-speaking emigrants 1933-1945; online-only publications since 2006. Frankfurt houses the Deutsches Exilarchiv 1933-1945 (exile publications, personal and organisational papers; unpublished testimonies on German-language emigration). A user account is needed; reference library for use in reading rooms; online catalogue. Pages opened do not mention parish or civil registers or genealogy.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. / (two sites, catalogue portal.dnb.de/opac.htm, Frankfurt Adickesallee 1); /DE/Benutzung/benutzung_node.html (account required; weekly card 5 EUR, annual card 25 EUR, free for ages 16-19; 'Archiv- und Praesenzbibliothek'); /DE/Professionell/Sammeln/sammeln_node.html (scope since 1913, exile prints 1933-1945); /DE/Ueber-uns/DEA/dea_node.html (Exilarchiv founded 1949). Same body as Q28657233 (Leipzig).

providers.name: Ethiopian National Archives and Library Agency (Wemezeker)
providers.what: National archives and library authority of Ethiopia (Wemezeker), formerly the Ethiopian Archives and Library Service. The site lists sections for legal deposit, archives administration, the Ethiopian Studies library, ancient literary heritage (manuscripts) and a reference library, and highlights manuscripts such as the Fetha Negest and a Qur'an from the 18th century. It links an online catalogue portal with simple search. The archives-administration page lists PDFs including a photograph collection and archival documents for study and research, but their contents were not readable. The pages do not state which record types (civil, parish, census) are held, nor fees. Mostly in Amharic.

providers.name: Archives nationales
providers.what: France's national archives, with reading rooms at Pierrefitte-sur-Seine and Paris (CARAN) and a virtual reading room. The page 'ce que vous trouverez' states it holds state records from the 7th century to now, records of 122 Paris notarial offices since the 16th century, private archives of families and persons, and series such as Revolutionary emigre records and passport applications, WWI regimental civil-status registers and Morts pour la France records, WWII deportation files, convoy lists and refugee records, and convict lists to 1865. It says civil-status acts 1792 to about 1920 are mostly held elsewhere, and soldiers' personnel files are at the Service historique de la Defense. Online: 31,300 finding aids and over 14 million images. Passenger lists and naturalisation are not mentioned on the pages opened.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. / (31 300 inventaires, 14 million images, reading rooms); /ce-que-vous-trouverez-aux-archives-nationales (holdings and series); /consulter-et-utiliser-nos-archives (access free, registration from age 10; freely communicable documents may be reproduced on site or remotely; reproduction charges not stated); /notaires-de-paris (notarial acts open after 75 years; search free in the virtual reading room or at CARAN; repertoires chronologiques and some acts digitised). Access 'free' refers to registration and consultation as the page states it; copy fees were not seen.

providers.name: Archives nationales du monde du travail
providers.what: French national archive service in Roubaix for the archives of companies, trade unions, associations and professions. Its genealogy page says it holds, for the companies concerned, personnel or payroll registers, matriculation registers, workplace accident files, litigation files and HR lists, often incomplete because companies sorted them first. It also holds mining personnel files for the Nord and Pas-de-Calais coalfields (files from before 1900 are digitised and name-searchable online; later files are inventoried but not yet digitised). It states it does not hold parish or civil registers, notarial archives or public-service staff files. Reading room: seat reservation required, free consultation, copies charged.
