Access 'mixed' because online images exist for some series and others are onsite only.

providers.name: Archives New Zealand (Te Rua Mahara o te Kāwanatanga)
providers.what: New Zealand's national archive. Its About page says it holds more than 7 million records dating from the early 19th century to today, with notable holdings such as Te Tiriti o Waitangi, the National Collection of War Art and the Women's Suffrage Petition, searchable online through 'Collections search'. It runs four reading rooms (Wellington, Auckland, Christchurch, Dunedin) and advises researchers and whanau, hapu and iwi seeking access to taonga. Only that one page could be read; specific family-history record types (e.g. immigration, military, land) were not seen on any page opened.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. /about: 'Aotearoa New Zealand's national archive'; more than 7 million records, early 19th century to today; four reading rooms; Collections search online. Other pages tried (family history, collections, research, locations) returned no content or 404, so record types and fees are not stated here. Coordinates from Wikidata P625.

providers.name: Centro Português de Fotografia
providers.what: Portuguese national photography centre in the former prison and appeal court in Porto, part of DGLAB. Its pages list a national photography collection, a collection of cameras and equipment, bibliographic holdings and acquisitions. It says it has 161 archival fonds and collections (141 with a general-level description) documenting photographic companies, organisations and institutions, and people and families. The catalogue is not yet fully online; document-level descriptions are in an online research service, and an image research and licensing service exists. The pages do not mention genealogy, parish or civil registers; they do not say whether the archives include portraits or studio work. A family historian might find photographs through the fonds list, but nothing here is a register source.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. cpf.pt home: collections menu (Coleção Nacional de Fotografia, Fundos Bibliográficos), visiting, image research; /fundos-e-colecoes/arquivos-e-colecoes/: '161 archival fonds and collections', catalogue 'not yet fully online'. No fees or genealogy stated. Address Largo Amor de Perdição, 4050-008 Porto.

providers.name: Arquivo Nacional da Torre do Tombo
providers.what: Portugal's national archive, housed in its own building at the Alameda da Universidade, Lisbon, and run by DGLAB. When read (Nov 2026) the site showed a maintenance notice after a security problem, with only contacts, reading-room reservation (CRAV) and the DigitArq portal available, so it did not describe its holdings. DigitArq (digitarq.arquivos.pt) describes itself as DGLAB's search portal: over 8 million records linked to over 63 million images, with online viewing, requests for reproductions, reading-room reservation and certificates. The pages read do not name parish registers, civil registration, notarial or emigration records, so those are not claimed here. The notice says the collections of the extinct Arquivo Distrital de Lisboa are accessible through Torre do Tombo.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. antt.dglab.gov.pt is a maintenance page (visiting address, hours PDFs, DigitArq, CRAV, list of district archives, note on Arquivo Distrital de Lisboa). digitarq.arquivos.pt says users can search, filter and consult documents and reproductions online 'gratuitamente' and that account registration is free; reproduction/certificate fees not stated. Access set to free on that DigitArq statement only; record types not stated on pages read. Access left unsurveyed here: the page says consultation and account registration are free, but not whether an account is needed to view images.

providers.name: Russian State Library
providers.what: Russia's national library in Moscow. Its collections page says it holds over 50 million storage units in 367 languages from the 6th century to the present, with about 3 million especially valuable items including rare books, archival materials and manuscripts (a Manuscripts Department and an Archive reading room are named). Over 3.3 million items are digitised in its electronic library, and there is an electronic and card catalogue (search.rsl.ru). Holdings are for use in reading rooms, not loan. Reader cards are free for Russian and foreign citizens aged 14 and over (foreigners need a passport with visa); remote registration is for Russian citizens only. Pages read do not mention genealogy or local-history collections. Several reading rooms were temporarily closed as of March 2026.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. rsl.ru home (Russian only seen), /fondy-i-katalogi/ (50 million units, 367 languages, 3.3 million digital), /vizit-v-biblioteku/ (Mon-Sat 9-20, use in reading rooms only), /vizit-v-biblioteku/stat-chitatelem/ (cards free, replacement plastic card 100 rubles, valid 5 years). No genealogy mention. Access left unsurveyed (mixed onsite and digital).

providers.name: Riksarkivet
providers.what: Sweden's National Archives, keeping the records of state agencies since 1618 (municipal, county council and regional archives are not held there). Nine reading rooms (Göteborg, Härnösand, Lund, Stockholm, Täby, Uppsala, Vadstena, Visby, Östersund); material is ordered in advance with a user account, to one reading room at a time. Online, the Digital Research Room (sok.riksarkivet.se) has a genealogy topic page that names church records (including Församlingsutdrag 1860-1940), censuses with over 24 million people searchable, Statistics Sweden births, marriages and deaths 1860-1949, emigration and immigration summary reports, Göteborg population registers 1713-1949, Stockholm registration cards 1926-1949, and orphanage registers. A catalogue (NAD) describes records not online. Copy and research-assignment service exists; prices not seen.
providers.triageNote: Read 2026-11-08. riksarkivet.se home, /utforska-och-bestall, /utforska-och-bestall/besok-vara-lasesalar (nine reading rooms, order to one at a time), /utforska-och-bestall/sok-i-arkiv-och-samlingar/kom-igang-med-forskningen (state-agency archives, NAD), and the genealogy topic page at sok.riksarkivet.se (record types as listed). No fees or free/paid statement found on these pages.

providers.name: Riksarkivet i Göteborg
providers.what: The Göteborg branch of the Swedish National Archives, at Arkivgatan 9, holding archives from the present Västra Götaland County, mainly from state agencies, plus some from companies, associations and private persons. Its page has headings for opening hours, visiting and ordering but showed no text under them, and a new Göteborg location is planned for 2027. The page does not mention genealogy or parish records. Via the national site, Göteborg is one of nine reading rooms, and the national genealogy topic page lists Göteborg population registers (mantalsskrivning) 1713-1949; whether those sit in this branch is not stated.

No genealogy or fee statement on its own page.

providers.name: Registro Civil de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires
providers.what: The civil registry of the City of Buenos Aires registers births, marriages and deaths and issues copies (partidas) of those registered in the city. Its certificate page states a request needs a miBA login through TAD, and that a regular copy is free under the Ley Tarifaria. The page also says the Registro Civil holds 1,164 twin parish books (Libros Parroquiales Gemelares) covering 1858 to 10 August 1886, the date the Registro Civil was created; the full parish archive is kept by the Archdiocese of Buenos Aires.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a directory sweep of Argentina; read on the institution's own site.

providers.name: Museo de la Inmigración (Hotel de los Inmigrantes)
providers.what: The museum, in the Hotel de los Inmigrantes at Av. Antártida Argentina 1355, Buenos Aires, has sections on Registros Históricos, a library and a photo gallery. Its page states it holds arrival records for people who came by ship to the Port of Buenos Aires between 1882 and 1953. Descendants can email an ancestor's full name (arrival date or ship name helps) to receive a free symbolic arrival certificate; for a legally valid certificate the page directs applicants to TAD at migraciones.gob.ar.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a directory sweep of Argentina; read on the institution's own site.

providers.name: Registro Provincial de las Personas (Provincia de Buenos Aires)
providers.what: The provincial civil registry of Buenos Aires Province. Its certificate-request page lets users ask online for a birth, death, marriage or civil-union record, or in person at a Delegación (Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 13:00). The page says only records registered in Buenos Aires Province can be requested and that a search may return a negative result.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a directory sweep of Argentina; read on the institution's own site.

providers.name: Archivo Histórico de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires
providers.what: Keeps historically valuable documentation produced by the City of Buenos Aires municipal government, plus original hand-drawn and printed maps from the municipal administration and the Dirección General de Tierras land and cadastral surveys. Topics named include water, lighting, streets, commerce, hospitals, epidemics, parks, transport and industry. The page says the documents for 1856 to 1900 are currently open to the public.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a directory sweep of Argentina; read on the institution's own site.

providers.name: Fundación IWO (Instituto Científico Judío) historic archive
providers.what: The IWO site says its historic archive holds more than 400 documentary collections (fondos) acquired from various producers, beginning with the founding of IWO in 1928. It also keeps a library maintained since 1935 and the Minkowski museum collection. The page lists online Yiddish resources but does not say whether the archive or library holdings can be consulted online.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a directory sweep of Argentina; read on the institution's own site.

providers.name: Archivo de Protocolos Notariales (Colegio de Escribanos de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires)
providers.what: The Colegio's archive keeps the notarial protocols (original deeds bound in volumes) of the City of Buenos Aires, at Alsina 2280 and Chorroarín 751. The Colegio states protocols from 1901 to 1982 are available at the Chorroarín site, and the archive page says notaries normally deposit protocols in the fifth year after the protocol year. Parties to a deed or a person with legitimate interest can consult at Alsina 2280 with DNI and an interest document, and an online query shows whether a protocol is in the Archive.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a directory sweep of Argentina; read on the institution's own site.

providers.name: Archivos Abiertos - Sistema de Archivos de la Defensa
providers.what: Portal of the Ministry of Defence archive system, listing eight archive institutions: the Ministry of Defence archive, Archivo General del Ejército, Servicio Histórico del Ejército, Archivo General de la Armada, Departamento de Estudios Históricos Navales, Archivo General de la Fuerza Aérea, the Air Force Dirección de Estudios Históricos and the UNDEF archive. It offers digitized files to view or download online and finding aids for the Armed Forces holdings, including an inventory of legajos of the Penal de Magdalena. Its FAQ says consultation is free and open to anyone, in person.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a directory sweep of Argentina; read on the institution's own site.

providers.name: Servicio Histórico del Ejército
providers.what: The Army's historical archive at Defensa 628/630, Buenos Aires, with about 650 linear metres of documents. The page offers a reading room, library, reference help and remote guidance by email (age@ejercito.mil.ar), Monday to Friday 8:00 to 13:00. It points to a Fondos y Colecciones documentales section for the holdings.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a directory sweep of Argentina; read on the institution's own site.

providers.name: Archivo General del Ejército
providers.what: Described on its page as an Archivo General Militar Nacional of about 5,000 linear metres, at Defensa 628/630, Buenos Aires. Sections named are Historia Institucional, Fondos y Colecciones documentales and Penal de Magdalena. It offers a reading room (Monday to Friday 8 to 13 h), reference help by email, photocopies and certifications.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a directory sweep of Argentina; read on the institution's own site.

providers.name: Archivo General de la Armada
providers.what: The Navy's general archive at Bolívar 1622, Buenos Aires, described as holding about 5,800 linear metres of documentation. The page offers a reading room (9:00 to 12:00), reference help, remote orientation by email (archivogeneral@armada.mil.ar) and paper photocopies. It lists a classification scheme (Cuadro de clasificación AGA) but the page itself does not name the series.

providers.name: Departamento de Estudios Históricos Navales (Armada Argentina)
providers.what: Naval historical archive at Av. Almirante Brown 401, Buenos Aires, holding about 500 linear metres of documents and roughly 27,000 photographs, plus a separate Fondo Isaac F. Rojas. It has a reading room (Monday to Thursday 8:00 to 14:00, Friday 8:00 to 12:00), a library and reference help by email (archivodehn@gmail.com).

providers.name: Dirección de Estudios Históricos de la Fuerza Aérea Argentina

providers.what: Site of the diocesan archive, cathedral chapter archive and seminary library of Girona. It lists parish archives and matrimonial dispensations among its sections. providers.name: Registro Civil — Ministerio de Justicia (birth, marriage and death certificates)

providers.name: DARA — Documentos y Archivos de Aragón
providers.what: Gobierno de Aragón portal with a search across 112 archives at every description level. providers.what: A genealogy portal that aims to publish the family relationships of people born, married, lived or died in the Algarve. The page says the data can be consulted using a shared login given on the page, and does not state record counts or coverage dates.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a directory sweep of Portugal; read on the institution's own site.

providers.name: Casa de Sarmento — Centro de Estudos do Património (Universidade do Minho)
providers.what: Heritage studies centre in Guimarães, a unit of the University of Minho set up in 2017. Its collections include the Sociedade Martins Sarmento archive, a genealogical repository, the ArchivAVE collection, a postcard collection, and a digital newspaper library; the Hemeroteca do Minho project covers titles from Braga, Guimarães, Barcelos and Vila Nova de Famalicão from 1822 to 1950. Many collections can be consulted online.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a directory sweep of Portugal; read on the institution's own site.

providers.name: Arquivo da Universidade de Coimbra
providers.what: The archive's search site lists the record groups parish registers, civil registration and notarial records among its categories. The page read gives no dates, places or access terms, so check the catalogue for what is covered.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a directory sweep of Portugal; read on the institution's own site.

providers.name: Arquivos.UÉ — Arquivo da Universidade de Évora e FUNDIS
providers.what: Joint platform of the University of Évora archive and the CIDEHUS research centre. It holds the university's own records and FUNDIS (Fundos Documentais de Instituições do Sul), a repository of fonds from institutions in southern Portugal created in 2009 and now migrated to this platform. It describes itself as an open repository, and also shows items such as the Arquivo Digital do Cante.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a directory sweep of Portugal; read on the institution's own site.

providers.name: Società Istriana di Archeologia e Storia Patria (SIASP)
providers.what: Historical society founded in 1884 in Parenzo, moved to Pola in 1927 and Venice after the Second World War, and based in Trieste since 1969. The site lists its archive collections (Archivio SIASP, Capitani Raspo, Fondo notai, Archivio Polesini, Archivio De Franceschi, Archivio Carli, Archivio Alfieri Seri) with 2017 guides, and a library, bibliography and indexes to Atti e Memorie 1884-2024. The archive is consulted by appointment by email.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a family-research session's use; read on the site.

providers.name: Archivio di Stato di Udine
providers.what: State archive of Udine, Via F. Urbanis 1. The front page shows noble family archives (Della Porta, di Toppo), the Perusini archive, the PNF archive and the Teatro Sociale archive, and has sections for online inventories, the SIAS state archives information system, the Friuli in prin database and a search for people and ancestors. It offers a reading room and a postal research service; the notary records (Notarile antico) are described in PDF inventories on the site.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a family-research session's use; read on the site.

providers.name: CISEI - Centro Internazionale Studi Emigrazione Italiana
providers.what: Emigration research centre with an online archive of Italian migrants, searchable by surname and first name and filterable by destination (Brazil, USA, Argentina, Canada, Australia). Records can show date, departure and destination places, voyage details and family members who travelled. The page says summary information is free and complete records are for Amici del Cisei (members); the archive can also be consulted at the MEM in Genoa (Galata Museo del Mare) and at MUSEL, Sestri Levante.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a family-research session's use; read on the site.

providers.name: Centro di ricerche storiche, Rovigno (CRS)
providers.what: Research centre of the Italian National Community in Istria, Fiume and Dalmatia, founded on a 1968 proposal. Its library (founded 1976) has over 70,000 volumes, 1,750 periodicals and 750 regional newspaper titles on Istria, Fiume/Kvarner, Dalmatia, Veneto and Friuli Venezia Giulia. Its archive (founded 1973) holds documents of the Italian community from 1945 onward plus earlier material, and about 4,000 maps; both are open on weekdays by prior notice.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a family-research session's use; read on the site.

providers.name: Findmypast (Australian edition)
providers.what: The Australian edition of Findmypast, which also links to the UK, international and Irish sites. It describes billions of British and Irish records: censuses 1851-1911 for England, Wales and Scotland, the 1921 Census, the 1939 Register, birth, marriage, death and parish records, military, institutions, travel and migration, and British and Irish newspapers. Searches can be limited to Australia and New Zealand, Ireland, Britain, the US and Canada, or the world. It offers a 7-day free trial and subscriptions, a family-tree builder with GEDCOM import, and a page of free records.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a family-research session's use; read on the site.

providers.name: Landesarchiv Berlin: civil registry records (Personenstandsunterlagen) request service
providers.what: Berlin service-portal page for requesting information or extracts from historical civil registry records (birth, marriage and death registers of Berlin Standesaemter) held by the Landesarchiv Berlin. The page says registers pass to the archive 110 years after a birth, 80 after a marriage and 30 after a death. The archive issues information or register extracts rather than certificates, and the researcher must name the Standesamt that recorded the event. The page gives no fixed fee and says processing typically takes 1 to 16 weeks; requests can be made online or in person by appointment.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a family-research session's use; read on the site.

providers.name: Gradska groblja Zagreb (Zagreb City Cemeteries)
providers.what: Official site of Zagreb City Cemeteries. Its menu names Mirogoj, Miroševac, Gaj urni (crematorium), Markovo polje and other cemeteries, and the funeral schedule also lists Lučko, Stenjevec and Remete. It has a deceased-person finder (Tražilica pokojnika) and pages for obituaries (Osmrtnice) and the funeral schedule. The front page does not describe the finder's coverage or date range.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a family-research session's use; read on the site.

providers.name: Associazione Fiumani Italiani nel Mondo (fiumemondo.com) and Anagrafe AFIM
providers.what: Site of the Associazione Fiumani Italiani nel Mondo (AFIM), based in Padova, for people from Fiume (Rijeka) and their descendants. Besides news, history, biographies, documents, cartography and a library, it hosts the Anagrafe AFIM, described as a register of more than 20,000 entries collected over about thirty years. The Anagrafe page shows a password prompt: the association issues a password on request, asking for name, surname and reason for access.
providers.triageNote: Added 8 Nov 2026 from a family-research session's use; read on the site.

providers.name: British Newspaper Archive
providers.what: Digitised British and Irish newspapers, searchable by name and date; viewing pages is subscription or pay-per-view. Listed because the D'Arcy archive cites it as a source it used (7 rows). Not surveyed by the Atlas: access class and holdings still need a person.
